subject: [SysSec '26] Updated accepted #1030 "Rethinking Memory Safety in Modern Systems"
body:
Accepted submission #1030 has been updated on the Symposium
on Systems Security '26 (SysSec '26) submission site. Final version and
Title and author certification were changed.
* Title: Rethinking Memory Safety in Modern Systems
* Authors: Michael Chen (Westbrook University);
Sarah Williams (Pacific Institute of Technology)
* Site: https://syssec26.hotcrp.com/paper/1030?cap=hcav1030SHrQMUSswKtY
Contact syssec26chairs@conference.org with any questions or concerns.


- SysSec '26 Submissions
https://syssec26.hotcrp.com
